name: spotlight-testimonial
title: Spotlight Testimonial
description: A wide pale section with a heading, then a single oversized testimonial under a round quote mark. The quote fades to the next automatically, each with a portrait, name and role, and three dots below switch between them.
use: A landing page wants one large rotating testimonial with minimal chrome and obvious dot controls.
avoid: Only three quotes are fixed, and autoplay runs every three seconds with no pause or reduced-motion respect.
a11y: Dots are labelled buttons and can be tabbed to, but the three-second autoplay has no pause and ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Off-white page with a centred black heading and a grey two-line intro. Below sits a pale circular quote-mark medallion, three lines of large dark quote text with one phrase in grey italics, a small round portrait, an uppercase name, a grey role and three small dots where the active one stretches into a short dark bar.
behaves: Every three seconds the current quote and author fade away and the next pair rises in. Clicking a dot jumps straight to that quote and widens the chosen dot while the others stay small.
customise: The three quotes, highlighted phrases, names, roles and photos are a hardcoded array; the three-second interval and greys need source edits.
weight: light: Only one quote is on screen at a time; a small fade runs every three seconds.
demo: Heading "Success Stories" with quotes from James Clear, Sarah Chen and Marcus Williams.
issues: The quote area is blank until the entrance animation runs, leaving a large empty section.
Autoplay advances every three seconds with no way to pause it.
polishWhy: Clean airy layout and a smooth quote fade; the grey highlight is faint and frame 1 is empty.
